subtitle: Flux RSS agrégé de tous les contenus : articles, notes, photos, bookmarks et jams

posts.description: Ah, how good it was back when I used to go to my record shop and the owner would put together a little selection of music I absolutely had to listen to. Those were the good old days, before these algorithms started throwing any old rubbish at you. Well, I’ve found that again with https://www.cantilever-music.com/ .
